items.question: During which months is Global Village in the UAE open each year?
items.gold: Global Village is open from November to April every year.
items.fact: Global Village open November to April annually

items.question: Which UAE airports have duty-free shops according to the UAE shopping guide?
items.gold: Duty-free shops are located at Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah and Fujairah airports.
items.fact: Duty-free shops exist at five named UAE airports
